description: This file is a shell script that determines the source date epoch for a given directory or file by attempting multiple methods: reading a version.date file, querying git or hg version control systems, or fallback to modification time. It outputs the determined epoch value.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks if there is a version.date file and reads the source date epoch from it.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the last commit timestamp from Git for the source directory.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the last commit timestamp from Mercurial for the source directory.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Gets the modification time of the script itself as a fallback method.
